versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.1 of vpick-ai-video-creator:

- Added detailed documentation on security, data handling, and MCP token management.
- Updated feature list and usage instructions for end-to-end AI video production (images, video, voiceover, music, lip sync, editing).
- Included pricing, specs, and model support tables for video, image, and audio generation.
- Provided comprehensive workflow and API usage examples for single-shot and MultiShot video generation.
- Clarified prerequisites for setup and VPick credit system integration.
